title: syzygium zeylanicum var. lineare
intro: Syzygium zeylanicum var. lineare, commonly known as Ceylon ironwood or Sri Lankan ironwood, is a plant species of the Syzygium genus in the family Myrtaceae. It is native to Sri Lanka and is traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Syzygium zeylanicum var. lineare include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The plant is also rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
